reasons: These are types only, so there is no behaviour to test here.
The design document they cite was not in the packet.

terms.meaning: a written description of what shape a piece of data must have
a made-up time of day used for replays, not a real observation time

sections.name: SOURCE_CLASSES, SourceClass
sections.title: Source classes
sections.what: Lists the five kinds of data source, from official live feed down to simulation.
sections.why: Mirrors the trust classes described in the design document it cites.
sections.watch_out: A new class must also be added to the priority and live tables.

sections.name: Receipt
sections.title: Receipt
sections.what: The record of where a number came from: source id, class, time seen, and an optional mark that the time is a replay clock.
sections.why: Replay times of day are not real, so they are marked so nobody reads them as real times.
sections.watch_out: The time of day on a replay should not be trusted.

sections.name: Sourced, DataState
sections.title: Sourced value and display states
sections.what: A value plus its receipt, and the fixed list of possible display states.
sections.why: A fixed list keeps labels consistent across the app.

sections.name: Presented
sections.title: Presented value
sections.what: The value after the source rules are applied, with its state, label text and age.
sections.why: Gives the page everything it needs to show a status badge.
sections.watch_out: The value can be null when pending, so callers must handle null.

summary: Defines the shape of every data value, its receipt, its display state and its presented form.
purpose: Makes every displayed number carry where it came from and how fresh it is.
why: The file comment says every displayed number carries a receipt. The deeper reasons are in the design document it cites, which is not in the packet.
how: Lists the allowed source classes, a receipt with source id, class and time, a sourced value that adds a value, the allowed display states, and the presented form.
inputs: None at run time; these are types only.
risks: A new source class added here but not to the priority and live tables in the config file goes unranked.
debug: A type error on a source class usually means a new class was added in only one place.
